data.name: TET1
data.description: Ten-eleven translocation methylcytosine dioxygenase 1, an epigenetic eraser that drives DNA demethylation of target promoters.
data.description_beginner: An enzyme that erases chemical 'off' tags (methyl groups) from DNA. Stripping those tags lets genes that had been silenced be read again, so it helps decide which parts of the genome a cell actually uses.
